name: Elder
overview: Scripture presents elders as appointed leaders with delegated authority to govern and serve their communities, as seen in the Mosaic system where wise men were made rulers and officers over the tribes (Deuteronomy 1:13,15). In the Christian church, elders were ordained in every congregation to oversee and shepherd the believers, with the apostles entrusting relief efforts to them (Acts 11:30; 14:23). This leadership role was integral to the church's order and governance, emphasizing responsibility, prayer, and faith in the Lord.
